description: A fake HubSpot toolkit (Composio's) for the CRM cases. It serves the one action the package names, its arguments shaped as Composio's input_parameters (trimmed to what the package uses) and its answer in Composio's {data, successful, error} envelope, and records every call for the graders. It never reaches HubSpot. It has no read and no update action: a note is the one call.

HUBSPOT_CREATE_NOTE.description: Creates a new HubSpot CRM note. Use when you need to add a timestamped note with optional attachments and associations to contacts, companies, deals, or tickets.

hs_timestamp.description: Creation time of the note. Either an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp (e.g., '2021-11-12T15:48:22Z') or Unix milliseconds since epoch.

hs_note_body.description: Text content of the note (up to 65,536 characters).

associations.description: List of associations to link with the note (e.g., contacts, deals, companies).

id.description: Unique ID of the existing CRM object to associate with the note.
